name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

2023.rateExcludedReason: Its annual security report counts incidents at UNC Hospitals on its central campus, whose patients, visitors and staff are not in its FTE, in its on-campus figures. So a rate per student would not measure its campus population. It has no rate; its counts are shown. Source: UNC-Chapel Hill 2025 Annual Security and Fire Safety Report (statistics 2022-2024): "In the tables below, "on campus" includes (1) all property on the central campus including UNC Hospitals and (2) all University-owned or controlled property reasonably contiguous to central campus", https://compliance.unc.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/1472/2025/10/2025-annual-security-and-fire-safety-report.pdf; the same sentence in the 2020 report (statistics 2017-2019), https://compliance.unc.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/1472/2026/09/2020-annual-security-and-fire-safety-report.pdf
